dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with irregular, crenulated outer perimeters. The most prominent mid-lateral annulus exhibits a sharp, high-frequency transition from dark exterior fur to a lighter-gray interior, featuring a constricted, figure-eight-like geometry. Adjacent structures show similar jagged edge gradients with varying degrees of completeness in their circular forms.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid-color pixel clusters. Localized, small concentrations of low-intensity (dark) pixels lacking internal gradients are scattered within the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli, primarily in the anterior and mid-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest and most high-contrast annuli (one mid-lateral, one mid-dorsal, and one posterior-dorsal) form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented longitudinally along the seal's body axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear array of approximately 9-10 regularly spaced, small, high-intensity white circular marks is located along the superior mid-dorsal ridge line.
